lesson.robot_design_lab.title: Robot Design Lab
lesson.robot_design_lab.summary: Build an action-pose robot, then change its face panel, antenna and accessories to create a silhouette with your own design choices.
lesson.robot_design_lab.step.core_silhou: Build a rounded robot head, a tapered body and an antenna so the silhouette already feels different from a box robot.
lesson.robot_design_lab.help.core_silhou: Look at the outside shape first. Make the head and torso different sizes and angles.
lesson.robot_design_lab.complete.core_si: Strong silhouette. Your robot already has its own design language.
lesson.robot_design_lab.step.raised_arm_: Give one arm a raised action pose, keep the other lower, then angle the two legs differently.
lesson.robot_design_lab.help.raised_arm_: Asymmetry makes the pose feel active. The two arms do not need to mirror each other.
lesson.robot_design_lab.complete.raised_: Great action pose. The robot feels ready to do something.
lesson.robot_design_lab.step.face_panel_: Add an uneven pair of eyes and a simple mouth panel, then decide how expressive you want the face to feel.
lesson.robot_design_lab.help.face_panel_: Changing eye size and spacing can change the robot's personality without adding lots of detail.
lesson.robot_design_lab.complete.face_pa: Your face panel gives the robot a clear personality.
lesson.robot_design_lab.step.accessory_v: Try a chest badge, wrist tool and side fin, then invent or skip any extra accessory you want.
lesson.robot_design_lab.help.accessory_v: Choose accessories that change the robot's job or silhouette, not just tiny decoration.
lesson.robot_design_lab.complete.accesso: Your design choices make this robot your own.
lesson.robot_design_lab.coloring.freehan: Color your robot freely. You can use one main body color and a contrasting accent color for tools and panels.
